notes: Ambiguities: (1) SKILL.md puts the literature check after the five reports are drafted, but the run order here was search first, then write; the reviewers' conclusions did not depend on it, only R2's addendum. (2) The task rules limit tools to the aggregation script and related_search.py, but Phase 0 requires scripts/integrity_scan.py; I ran it (clean, local only) and recorded this. (3) related_search.py `benchmarks` returned empty for TriviaQA (not recognised as a known benchmark) so scout was run by name manually; `search` output is very long (full abstracts), hard to scan. (4) The EIC rule on a one-step composite/rating disagreement near a band edge is clear, but the script's composite_band (49.5 -> band 2) uses a threshold at 50 that differs from the 50-59 'Borderline Reject' decision mapping wording only by rounding; worth stating in the docs. (5) Ordinal scale-consistency: pool_position 33-52 for Overall 2-3 and a composite just under 50 produce the cross-check flag even with consistent reviewers. (6) The 'Phase 1.6 report check' asks for dropped/rewritten weaknesses but reports are written once, so listing 'draft' weaknesses is partly retrospective. (7) Figures were unavailable, so Fig. 2 (think mode) could not be checked and Fig. 3 model attribution was inferred from matching numbers. (8) Path typos in long bash commands cost retries; absolute-path commands with pipes sometimes triggered approval prompts.
